Class ProductOneSEVPA<L1,L2,I>

java.lang.Object

net.automatalib.util.automaton.vpa.ProductOneSEVPA<L1,L2,I>
Type Parameters:
L1 - location type of first 1-SEVPA
L2 - location type of second 1-SEVPA
I - input alphabet type
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Pair<L1,L2>>, Automaton<Pair<L1,L2>,I,Pair<L1,L2>>, FiniteRepresentation, InitialState<Pair<L1,L2>>, InitialStates<Pair<L1,L2>>, InputAlphabetHolder<I>, Output<I,Boolean>, StateIDs<Pair<L1,L2>>, SuffixOutput<I,Boolean>, SimpleAutomaton<Pair<L1,L2>,I>, UniversalAutomaton<Pair<L1,L2>,I,Pair<L1,L2>,Boolean,Void>, OneSEVPA<Pair<L1,L2>,I>, SEVPA<Pair<L1,L2>,I>, GraphViewable, DeterministicSemantics, Semantics, SimpleTS<Pair<L1,L2>,I>, TransitionSystem<Pair<L1,L2>,I,Pair<L1,L2>>, UniversalTransitionSystem<Pair<L1,L2>,I,Pair<L1,L2>,Boolean,Void>
public class ProductOneSEVPA<L1,L2,I> extends AbstractSEVPA<Pair<L1,L2>,I> implements OneSEVPA<Pair<L1,L2>,I>
Production automaton that allows to join two given OneSEVPAs. Acceptance semantics of the product automaton depends on the given AcceptanceCombiner.
